summary: A BEAUTIFUL PLAY IS  THE GOLDEN GOAL
details: Lunar & Martian Heritage Explorer is an interactive web and mobile educational platform designed to tell the untold stories of NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars. How It Works: Users explore a 3D interactive surface map of the Moon and Mars, tap on pinned locations of historic NASA landers and rovers (such as Apollo 11, Opportunity, and Curiosity), and view real NASA imagery, mission timelines, scientific discoveries, and fun facts. Tools & NASA Data Used: Our project utilizes official NASA open data, Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) imagery, and Mars rover archives, combined with an accessible, story-driven user interface designed for students, teachers, and space enthusiasts. Impact & Creativity: By transforming static space archives into an engaging visual museum, our solution preserves humanity's off-world heritage and inspires future generations to learn about space exploration.
